methods.method_name_cn: Amazon Vine 新品评价加速
methods.objective: 在合规前提下加速新品获得真实高质量Review
applicable_conditions: Product detail page has fewer than 30 reviews
Brand Registry role when required or eligible generic product
not_applicable_conditions: ASIN already has 30 or more reviews
steps: Check Vine eligibility in Seller Central
Enroll units up to current program limit
Monitor claimed units and published reviews
Use review themes to improve listing/product experience

cost_model.note: Current fee depends on enrollment tier and marketplace; verify in Seller Central before action.

expected_impact.primary: Increase authentic review count and review depth during launch

methods.method_name_cn: Seller Central Request a Review 标准邀评
methods.objective: 通过Amazon官方邀评功能提高已成交订单产生Review的概率
applicable_conditions: Order Detail page exposes Request a Review feature
not_applicable_conditions: Trying to request only positive reviews
Offering incentives, refunds, rebates, gifts or compensation for a review
Asking buyers to change or remove negative reviews
steps: Use Amazon's Request a Review feature
Do not add selective positive-review language or incentives
Measure review request coverage and downstream review rate

expected_impact.primary: Increase compliant review-request coverage across eligible orders

methods.method_name_cn: Review主题驱动的产品体验修复循环
methods.objective: 通过减少缺陷、误解和体验落差，提升自然好评率和长期星级稳定性
applicable_conditions: Enough authentic review or return-reason data exists
Recurring complaint themes can be mapped to controllable product/listing causes
not_applicable_conditions: Manipulating, suppressing, removing or selectively diverting negative reviews
steps: Map each theme to product defect, packaging, instructions, listing expectation or fulfillment cause
Measure complaint-theme recurrence and star-rating trend after change

expected_impact.primary: Improve natural review quality and reduce negative review drivers

blocked_patterns: Compensation or incentive in exchange for a review
Refund or reimbursement conditional on a review
Asking a reviewer to change or remove a negative review
Diverting negative review customers away from Amazon while sending positive customers to Amazon
Using employees, family members, friends or controlled accounts to review products
Creating variation relationships for review aggregation manipulation
